author: Albert Mulder
releaseNotes:
App 1.3.1 / drivers 1.2.1: Fixes errors like 'No signature of method ... getDeviceTokenFor()' or '... getMqttCredentials()' (polls failing, MQTT not connecting) when the drivers were updated but the app was not. The drivers and app now work with each other's older versions, so a partial update no longer breaks anything. CHECK AFTER UPDATING: open the YoLink app - the version shown at the top should be 1.3.1. If it is older, HPM did not update the app (common if it was installed by hand): in HPM use Repair on this package, or Match Up and then Update. Then open the YoLink app and click Done once.
NEW APP LOCATION (since 1.3.0): YoLink Device Local Service appears under Integrations in the Hubitat sidebar, not Apps (hub firmware 2.5.0+; older firmware still shows it under Apps). Existing setup and devices are unchanged.
1.3.0 / 1.2.0: device-token refresh fixed; access token refreshed before expiry and on HTTP 401; battery 0 shows 0% (was -1%); partial reports no longer reset contact/leak/motion/power state; MQTT Listener reset keeps working, re-subscribes and backs off on reconnect; THSensor temperature correction converted correctly; secrets no longer logged; fewer forced events; debug logging auto-off after 30 minutes. HPM names/namespace now match the code - run Match Up if HPM does not see the installed app/drivers.
